info.title: AEGIS API
info.description: Multi-tenant SaaS platform API. OpenAPI docs at /docs.

schema.title: Response My Orgs Orgs Mine Get
Response List Members Orgs  Org Id  Members Get
Response List Projects Orgs  Org Id  Projects Get
Response List Tasks Orgs  Org Id  Projects  Project Id  Tasks Get
Response List Keys Orgs  Org Id  Api Keys Get
Response My Progress Challenges Progress Me Get
Response My Teams Teams Mine Get
Response List Team Members Teams  Team Id  Members Get
Response List Team Sessions Teams  Team Id  Sessions Get
Response My Reports Teams Reports Mine Get
Response List Team Reports Teams  Team Id  Reports Get

get.description:
Red Team report export. Markdown only (no PDF renderer dependency) —
pipe through `pandoc` or any Markdown-to-PDF tool if a PDF is needed.

schema.title: Response List Lab Verifications Teams Reports  Report Id  Lab Verifications Get
Response User Leaderboard Leaderboard Users Get
Response Team Leaderboard Leaderboard Teams Get
Response My Achievements Achievements Me Get
Response My Classrooms Classrooms Mine Get
Response List Students Classrooms  Classroom Id  Students Get
Response List Assignments Classrooms  Classroom Id  Assignments Get

get.description:
Completion report: every student's progress on every assigned
challenge. Instructor-only — this is the privacy boundary: a student
can see their own progress via /challenges/progress/me, not everyone
else's.

schema.title: Response Classroom Progress Classrooms  Classroom Id  Progress Get
Response List Events Orgs  Org Id  Security Events Get

get.description:
The same security-event feed as GET /events, as a CSV download for
offline review. Same identity rules (admin/owner JWT, or an org API key
with the read scope), same filters, capped at 5000 rows per export.

schema.title: Response List Documents Orgs  Org Id  Documents Get
Response List Webhooks Orgs  Org Id  Webhooks Get

scope_note.title: Scope Note
scope_note.default: Evidence about the lab's reference implementation (its vulnerable and hardened endpoints), not proof that a team remediated anything. This does not change the report's remediation status.
